comment: Canonical Chart Aid style parameters. PowerPoint stores these as chartstyle.txt lines in its sandbox folder (apps/powerpoint/src/modChartStyle.bas, KeyDefs); Google Slides stores the same flat keys in shared Document Properties (apps/google-slides/src/core/chart-style.ts). A key may be written globally ('LabelSizePt') or scoped to one chart kind ('COL.LabelSizePt'), and the scoped value always wins.

keys.description: Bar group width as share of category slot (clustered)

paletteFamilies.comment: Applying a Color Theme writes all three; Edit Colors edits one at a time.
